title: The Art of New Phyrexia's Factions

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Machine civilization run on artifacts and black mana that has won a home plane once more by infecting Mirrodin; it invades to control, convert and corrupt other worlds.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane infected by Phyrexia and turned into New Phyrexia; elements of Mirrodin cling to survival.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexia's renewed home plane, split into five color-aligned Phyrexian factions.

entities.name: The Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Red-aligned Phyrexian faction tied to the Furnace Layer, showing an element of compassion Phyrexia lacked before.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: Phyrexia's hellish industrial zone where the Phyrexian system's infrastructure is maintained.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara that hungers for life energy (vis) after losing white and green mana.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane that broke into five shards.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: Mirrodin region of metal-infused beasts in a jungle of verdigris-stained copper.

events.summary: Phyrexia triumphs over Mirrodin, infecting it and turning it into New Phyrexia.
events.quote: it infected a world, it grew and evolved within its host, and then it metastasized into victory.

events.summary: Alara breaks into five shards, so Grixis feels a strong hunger for white and green mana.
events.quote: When Alara broke into its five shards, the hunger for those life-oriented colors of mana, white and green, was strongly felt.

relations.quote: Red-aligned Phyrexia has the closest relationship to the Furnace Layer

relations.note: Phyrexia invades to control and corrupt other worlds.
relations.quote: it invades because it really wants to control, convert, and corrupt other worlds.
